## Tech workers

Take the nine distortions to work as a red-team checklist: which does your product structurally reward, even unintentionally? Prototype one counter-distortion feature — friction before sharing, context before outrage, provenance made visible. Deepen your platform knowledge: you cannot design against dynamics you cannot name.
